- **2026 Oct 12** Oral presentation at CCS26  
  I presented my research titled: **"Climate-Responsive Irrigation Optimization in Arid Regions:an Integrated Climate-Crop Framework"** in the 2026 Conference on Complex Systems (**CCS26**) in Binghamton, NY.
- **2025 Dec 13** Oral presentation at AGU25 
  I presented my research titled: **"Integrated Climate–Crop Modeling to Advance Water Management in Rural and Drought-Prone Regions"** in the American Geophysical Union (**AGU25**) in New Orleans, LA.
- **2025 Aug 4:** Oral presentation at NABEC 2025  
  I presented my research titled: **"Downscaled assessment of climate change impacts on agriculture and water management: a case study of the Navajo Nation"** in the Northeast Agricultural / Biological Engineering Conference (**NABEC 2025**) in Ithaca, NY.
